stories.title: School leaders’ union and Welsh Government agree 14 working days of talks over pay and ALN funding
stories.summary: School leaders’ union NAHT Cymru and the Welsh Government have agreed to 14 working days of intensive negotiations to try to settle a dispute over pay, workload and school funding. stories.title: Estimates say routine flu vaccination would have prevented 800 hospital admissions in Wales last winter
stories.summary: Routine flu vaccination is estimated to have prevented more than 800 flu-related hospital admissions in Wales last winter. Public Health Wales estimates that, without vaccination, 50 per cent more people would have been admitted to hospital. stories.title: Largest commercial properties to fund permanent rates cut for Wrexham hospitality and leisure
stories.summary: Pubs, cafés, hotels, gyms and other hospitality and leisure venues in Wrexham are set to get a permanent 30% cut in business rates, a year after the previous Welsh Government said the lower rate would be for shops only. stories.title: Caergwrle Methodist Church solar panels approved against planning officers’ advice
stories.summary: A church in a Flintshire conservation area has been granted permission to install solar panel against officers recommendations. While not itself a listed building, Caergwrle Methodist Church is situated in the heart of the village’s conservation area.
